changes.title: Desktop Bubble Typography & Icon Retention on Mobile
changes.description: Preserved full desktop typography (0.72rem) and icon scale (1.6rem) for mobile category bubbles while reducing internal padding, paired with a clean icon-only circular top changelog button on mobile.

changes.title: Global Footer Links Placement Below All SPA Subviews
changes.description: Relocated the Source Code and Documentation footer link pills below GROUP_SPA_SECTIONS so they consistently appear at the very bottom of every category page and the home hub.

changes.title: Minimal Mobile Bubble Padding & Enhanced Link Separation
changes.description: Reduced excessive internal padding on mobile category bubbles down to 1px with scaled typography and icon sizes, while expanding the visual safety gap and physical separation distance between circular links.

changes.title: Centered Community Social Links Row
changes.description: Centered the community social links row directly beneath the About section title on all devices for balanced horizontal symmetry.

changes.title: Clean Mobile Header Changelog Button
changes.description: Streamlined the header Changelog button on mobile viewports by hiding the version badge pill, displaying only the clear icon and label.

changes.title: Unified About & Socials Section with Clean Background
changes.description: Merged the About and Socials sections into a seamless borderless layout with direct social icon links placed beneath the heading, concise description copy, and modern glass pill links for Source Code and Documentation.

changes.title: Header Changelog Pill & Sidebar Streamlining
changes.description: Moved the Changelog trigger button directly into the top header navigation bar next to login and commented out the legacy sidebar for an uncluttered single-page browsing experience.

changes.title: Multi-Category Top 3 Featured Project Randomizer
changes.description: Expanded the Featured Projects showcase to dynamically draw from across all 10 project datasets, selecting at random from the top 3 of each category for an unpredictable, multi-project gallery cycling on every visit.

changes.title: Vertical Tags Arrangement Under Project Thumbnail
changes.description: Relocated ranking and category badges directly underneath project thumbnails in a neat vertical stack, keeping both desktop and mobile views aligned without overlapping descriptions.

changes.title: Top-Left Brand Subtitle & Left-to-Right Typewriter Animation
changes.description: Relocated portal subtitles directly below the top-left site brand logo with a dynamic left-to-right typewriter effect and smooth tag reveal, completely clearing the redundant hero section.

changes.title: Featured Projects Compact Mobile Layout & Integrated Badges
changes.description: Optimized the featured project carousel for mobile screens with a significantly reduced height, left-aligned thumbnail with visit button underneath, right-aligned project details, and bottom-right corner ranking tags.

changes.title: Compact Mobile Floating Bubbles & Single-Screen Discovery
changes.description: Reduced diameter and padding for resource bubbles on mobile screens, fitting all 11 category links comfortably within a single viewport without tall canvas scrolling.

changes.title: Silky Smooth 7-Second Single Inactivity Auto-Scroll
changes.description: Upgraded idle inactivity detection to trigger after exactly 7 seconds of inactivity for the first time only, smoothly gliding downward to the Explore Hub Resources with cubic physics easing.

changes.title: Automated Visitor Changelog Modal & Service Worker Version Detection
changes.description: Implemented automated 'What's New' changelog modal that triggers whenever a new Service Worker cache version is deployed, featuring desktop and mobile trigger buttons, version history accordion, and offline fallback.

changes.title: Centered Intro Preloader with Corner Docking Animation
changes.description: Engineered an introductory loading screen that displays centered on load and seamlessly glides into the top-left logo position using dynamic bounding rect calculations.

changes.title: Dynamic Featured Projects Changing Gallery Carousel
changes.description: Built an interactive showcase carousel randomly presenting top-ranked projects from curated collections with auto-rotation, arrow navigation, and pagination indicators.

changes.title: Playful Floating Resource Bubbles Navigation
changes.description: Introduced an organic floating bubble canvas for exploring materials, tools, guidance, community links, and capstones with dynamic physics-inspired micro-animations.

changes.title: Supabase Authentication Centralization & Secure RLS
changes.description: Secured Supabase client access, centralized configuration in env-config.js, and implemented Row Level Security policies for user stars and capstone submissions.
